classic_5bar.note: Fractal at bar[i] is confirmed only after bar[i+2] closes

adaptive.formula: period = max(1, min(5, round(base * ATR(14) / ATR(50))))
adaptive.note: Use adaptive when ATR(14)/ATR(50) > 1.5 — switches left/right from 2 to 3

UP_fractal.meaning: potential resistance / stop-hunt high / liquidity above

DOWN_fractal.meaning: potential support / stop-hunt low / liquidity below

direction_rule.description: Direction determined by the most recently BROKEN fractal

BULL.meaning: Price broke above the last fractal high — buyers in control

BEAR.meaning: Price broke below the last fractal low — sellers in control

NEUTRAL.condition: no fractal broken OR most recent breaks cancel each other

direction_rule.note: Track both fractal_high and fractal_low breaks. The MORE RECENT break wins.

invalidation_rules.action: discard — fractal is stale on M1 (> 20 minutes old)

invalidation_rules.condition: new fractal forms in opposite direction before price breaks the existing one
invalidation_rules.action: old fractal loses active status — direction becomes contested
skip — not enough room to profit after spread
entry order expired — cancel pending Stop Buy/Sell
no trade — alligator is sleeping / market is ranging

alligator_filter.description: Williams Alligator filter — fractals only valid outside Alligator lines

expanding_definition.bull_expanding: lips > teeth > jaw AND all three increasing over last 3 bars
expanding_definition.bear_expanding: lips < teeth < jaw AND all three decreasing over last 3 bars

entry_rules.BUY: valid UP fractal + alligator bull expanding → Stop Buy at fractal_high + 1 tick
entry_rules.SELL: valid DOWN fractal + alligator bear expanding → Stop Sell at fractal_low - 1 tick

gate_rules.conflict: skip — do not trade against HTF structure

htf_confluence.confluence_zone_definition: M15 fractal within 20pt of M1 fractal → strong zone, +10% confidence bonus

recommended_config.description: Best settings for XAUUSDm M1 scalping with 280-308pt spread
reasoning: left=2/right=2 is fast enough for M1 scalping; switch to 3/3 when ATR spikes
Alligator filter eliminates fractals inside ranging/consolidated price — critical for M1 gold
HTF gate (M15) prevents fading the dominant structure — biggest single edge improvement
Spread filter 3x eliminates trades where the edge is eaten by spread before price moves
20-bar age limit prevents acting on stale structure from 20+ minutes ago
